mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dispute_ai_reviews (dispute_id, request_key, status, source, provider, model, prompt_version, input_hash) VALUES (#{disputeId}, #{requestKey}, 'PENDING', 'SIMULATED_LLM', #{provider}, #{model}, #{promptVersion}, #{inputHash})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS reviewId, r.dispute_id AS disputeId, d.work_case_id AS workCaseId FROM dispute_ai_reviews r JOIN ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY dispute_id ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC ) AS attemptNo FROM dispute_ai_reviews ) attempt ON attempt.id = r.id JOIN disputes d ON d.id = r.dispute_id WHERE ( r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.created_at <= TIMESTAMPADD( SECOND, CASE attempt.attemptNo WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN -2 WHEN 3 THEN -10 WHEN 4 THEN -30 WHEN 5 THEN -60 WHEN 6 THEN -300 ELSE -600 END, #{eligibilityTime} ) ) OR (r.status = 'PROCESSING' AND r.lease_until <= #{eligibilityTime}) ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id AS reviewId, dispute_id AS disputeId, request_key AS requestKey, status AS status, source AS source, provider AS provider, model AS model, prompt_version AS promptVersion, input_hash AS inputHash, decision AS decision, CAST(reason_codes AS CHAR) AS reasonCodesJson, summary AS summary, confidence AS confidence, provider_response_id AS providerResponseId, failure_code AS failureCode, lease_until AS leaseUntil, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt FROM dispute_ai_reviews WHERE id = #{reviewId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dispute_ai_reviews SET status = 'PROCESSING', lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, started_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND request_key = #{requestKey} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE dispute_ai_reviews SET status = 'COMPLETED', decision = #{decision}, reason_codes = #{reasonCodesJson}, summary = #{summary}, confidence = #{confidence}, provider_response_id = #{providerResponseId}, failure_code = NULL, lease_until = NULL, completed_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND request_key = #{requestKey} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE dispute_ai_reviews SET status = 'FAILED', decision = NULL, reason_codes = NULL, summary = NULL, confidence = NULL, provider_response_id = NULL, failure_code = #{failureCode}, lease_until = NULL, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW(6)), completed_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND request_key = #{requestKey} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
